about.title: Ridgecrest Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Losing a family member in a Ridgecrest traffic collision changes everything, and the last thing a grieving family should have to manage is a legal process with strict rules and a ticking clock. Kern County recorded a traffic death alongside dozens of injury collisions in the most recent final year of data, a reminder that these losses happen on ordinary roads people drive every day, including corridors like N China Lake Boulevard and E Ridgecrest Boulevard. California law gives certain surviving family members, starting with a spouse, domestic partner, or children, the right to pursue a wrongful death claim, but that right comes with a two-year filing deadline that moves faster when a government entity is involved. LawProactive is a free service that connects you with an independent personal injury attorney who can review what happened, explain who qualifies to file, and handle the case on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless there's a recovery. You focus on your family; let someone else carry the legal weight.

whyChoose.title: Why Ridgecrest Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Standing Rules Are Sorted Out Early
items.desc: California limits who can bring a wrongful death claim, prioritizing spouses, domestic partners, and children before other dependents or heirs. An attorney can clarify quickly who in your family qualifies to file.

items.title: The Clock Starts Immediately
items.desc: You generally have two years from the date of death to file, and that window shortens considerably if a government entity or public roadway maintenance is involved. Acting early preserves evidence and protects your family's rights.

items.title: No Upfront Cost During Grief
items.desc: Attorneys in our network work on contingency, so there's no fee unless there's a recovery for funeral costs, lost financial support, or loss of companionship. You won't be asked to pay out of pocket to get answers.

items.question: Who in my family is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: California law generally gives first priority to a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children. If none of those relatives exist, other dependents or heirs may have standing under certain circumstances. An attorney can review your family's specific situation and confirm who is eligible to file.

items.question: How long do we have to file after a fatal crash in Ridgecrest?
items.answer: The general deadline is two years from the date of death, but that timeline can be much shorter if the claim involves a government entity, such as a road defect on a county-maintained corridor. Because Ridgecrest sees regular traffic on roads like Rt 178 and S China Lake Boulevard, it's worth having an attorney check this early rather than assuming you have the full two years.

items.question: What kinds of losses can a wrongful death claim cover?
items.answer: These claims can address funeral and burial expenses, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. Every family's losses look different, and an attorney can walk through what applies to your situation without promising a specific outcome.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim connected to a criminal case against the driver?
items.answer: No, a wrongful death claim is a separate civil action, even if the driver also faces criminal charges. The two proceedings run independently, and a criminal outcome, or lack of one, does not determine whether your family can pursue civil compensation.
